title: Towards a more structured search for Erdős-Gyárfás counter-examples
summary: The Erdős-Gyárfás conjecture posits that every graph with minimum degree at least three contains a cycle of length some power of two. We prove a few simple structural properties for any minimal counter-example to this conjecture. In particular, the fraction of its vertices of degree three must be greater than $2/3$, thus improving on the prior bound of $4/7$ (Carr, 2026). Furthermore, it is either biconnected or the $1$-clique-sum of two biconnected graphs.
